description: DriveArena is a generative driving-simulation platform published by Shanghai AI Laboratory and collaborating universities. It connects a TrafficManager, WorldDreamer and driving-agent service through FastAPI to create controllable open- or closed-loop road scenarios. Inputs include road networks, trained generation models and a selected driving agent; outputs include generated visual scenes and simulated driving behaviour. Geographic coverage is configurable; the repository illustrates Boston and Singapore routes and supports networks beyond those examples. Public source is free under Apache-2.0, while model weights and training datasets require separate retrieval and terms. A limitation is that the README still marks evaluation code and development tutorials as unfinished, despite published demonstration results. Running the system also requires several services, with a local screen for TrafficManager and suitable compute for generation and agents. It supports research on vision-based road-control simulations and complements SUMO (model-sumo). The README cites the 2024 DriveArena preprint and links explicit run instructions. No weights, imagery, datasets or service deployments were obtained.
